newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan end-Oct kerosene stocks down 0.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan end-Oct kerosene stocks down 0.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's kerosene stockpiles stood at 4.95 million kilolitres (kl) as of the end of October, down 0.8 percent from a year earlier but up 3.9 percent from a month earlier, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry said on Friday.
Kerosene stockpiles saw a year-on-year decline at the end of October after registering an increase on a year-on-year basis for the first time in 17 months in September.
Refiners have been keeping oil product stockpiles at low levels in order to cut storage costs. But they need to build up stocks of kerosene, used for heating, as the winter season approaches.
Domestic sales of kerosene during the four-month period from November to February acount for about 60 percent of the total annual sales in volume.
